ns2:course.label: Food Ingredient Technology
ns2:course.description: Explores the research, science and technology of the production of safe, high quality food ingredients through the application of food chemistry, food microbiology, and food processing principles. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FSHN 414 or consent of the instructor. FSHN majors only, junior standing required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FSHN 414 or consent of the instructor. FSHN majors only, junior standing required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
